messages:
eva: heads-up: just finished a staged bring-up for pioneer-x (new arch) quantized Q4A. quick smoke shows locale-specific token join issues when using prefix kvcache + suffix prompts. posting repro and initial metrics.

haruto: can you paste a minimal repro?

meera: dropping locale sweep results would help too. curious if this is CJK-only or broader.

eva: repro below — two runs: (1) fresh generation without cache, (2) use kvcache to pre-prime prefix. note the punctuation and occasional invisible joiner in the warm run.

```
# prompt 1 (fresh)
input: system: Translate to English.
user: ontext: [zh] 今日は、商品を買いました。
expected: I bought a product today.

# prompt 2 (warm, prefix cached)
prefix (cached): [zh] 前回記録
user: 今日は、商品を買いました。
observed warm output: 前回記録E280今日は、商品を買いました。
# note: unwanted control / zero-width char inserted between prefix and user sentence, ideographic comma behavior differs
```

eva: metrics snapshot (small eval set, 400 examples):
- baseline fp16 (current-serving): zh->en BLEU 29.1, chrF 52.3
- pioneer-x fp16 cold: BLEU 28.6, chrF 51.8
- pioneer-x Q4A cold: BLEU 28.1, chrF 51.5
- pioneer-x Q4A warm (kvcache primed): BLEU 25.9, chrF 47.2

haruto: that -2.2 BLEU drop from cold->warm for Q4A is large. does warm path change detokenization or just tokenization?

meera: I ran a token-level diff on a sample: warm_path_tokens -> [\u4E0A\u6B21,ZWJ,\u3053], cold_path_tokens -> [\u4E0A\u6B21,SP,\u3053]. So ZX/ZWJ characters are appearing in merges. Looks like kvcache concatenation is restoring internal byte markers that tokenizer normally collapses.

infra-bot: deploy bot: staged canary pioneer-x/q4a started on cluster-7 at 2026-03-21T10:12Z

tanya: ran a locale sweep (zh/ja/ko/he) over 1k samples with beam=5. per-locale chrF deltas (warm vs fp16 baseline): zh: -5.0, ja: -1.1, ko: -0.8, he (RTL): -0.4. So mostly East Asian.

meera: added a quick check: when prefix ends with an ideographic character (U+3002, U+FF0C, etc.), tokenizer expects no extra spacer. kvcache join currently inserts raw bytes and then tokenizer re-scan sees a non-break and emits ZWJ. buggy.

haruto: potential root causes: 1) tokenizer normalization step is skipped for cache-merged spans; 2) quantized kernel changes token emission probabilities near boundaries; 3) detokenizer postprocess differs for warm path. Need to triage.

eva: proposed immediate actions:
- run bisect across tokenizer changes + runtime merges (last 6 months)
- add unit test in tokenizer suite simulating prefix+kvcache concatenation with CJK punctuation cases
- run full eval across quant modes (Q3B/Q4A/Q5/QP) and fp16 to see quant sensitivity
- short-term mitigation: do an on-the-fly re-normalize() of the joined string before re-tokenizing on cache read (cheap canary)

meera: I prototyped re-normalize() in the runtime and re-ran the 200-sample sweep. improvement: zh chrF delta warm->baseline reduced from -4.9 to -1.2, but some japanese compounds broke where ZWJ helped binding. so locale-aware policy needed.

haruto: can we gate re-normalize by locale tag on the prefix? if prefix metadata contains language hint we can apply only for CJK.

eva: yes. also test rule: when tokenizer emits a spacer_token for a following grapheme in cold path, ensure kvcache insertion emits the same spacer. That check can be unit-tested.

eval-bot: automated full-run queued: gs://redwood-evals/pioneer-x/q4a/2026-03-21/run_1742223334/

infra-bot: reminder: rolling canary freeze in 1h. if we can't confidently mitigate, recommend pause.

tanya: I added a per-sample diff UI to the eval dashboard (https://redwood.internal/evals/pioneer-x/prefix-join-diffs) and flagged top-30 zh regressions for labeling.

eva: ok team: liason plan: @haruto will run bisect on tokenizer/runtime, @meera will harden unit tests + experiment with locale-gated normalization; @tanya will label the 30 worst examples for triage. If mitigation looks OK we'll deploy canary with normalization-for-cjk toggled, otherwise pause Q4A rollout.

haruto: starting bisect now. ping if you need logs or intermediate tarballs.

meera: repro commands I used locally: 
```
# local repro (conda env)
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python tests/repro_kv_join.py --model pioneer-x:q4a --samples samples/prefix_cases.txt --use-kvcache
```

eva: great. keep updates here. adding to triage board and linking the eval artifacts. :mag:
